title: Baller League will no longer be shown on Sky Sports
summary: The Baller League, a six-a-side tournament, will no longer air on Sky Sports but will continue streaming on YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok. This shift reflects the changing landscape of sports broadcasting toward digital platforms.
content: The six-a-side tournament will continue to broadcast on YouTube, Twitch and TikTok.

zh.title: 球员超级联赛将不再在天空体育频道播出
zh.summary: 这项六人制足球赛事球员超级联赛将不再在天空体育频道播出，但将继续在YouTube、Twitch和TikTok上直播。这一转变反映了体育广播向数字平台转变的趋势。

title: Sunday date for Old Firm in League Cup quarter-finals
summary: Rangers will host Celtic on Sunday 13 September at noon in the final League Cup quarter-final match, with Stenhousemuir facing Hearts on Friday evening. The fixture schedule completes the Premier Sports Cup quarter-final lineup.
content: Rangers are to host Celtic at noon on Sunday 13 September in the last of the Premier Sports Cup quarter finals, while there is a Friday night kick-off for Stenhousemuir v Hearts.

zh.title: 联赛杯四分之一决赛：老字号德比定在周日进行

title: Why Fernandez uncertainty has echoes of Isak saga
summary: Enzo Fernandez's uncertain future and potential move to Manchester City mirrors the complexity of Alexander Isak's transfer last year, creating complications for Chelsea. The protracted negotiations highlight ongoing challenges in modern football transfers.
content: Enzo Fernandez's possible Manchester City move is following the pattern of Alexander Isak's transfer last summer - and creating headaches for Chelsea.
